title: thelypteris totta
intro: Thelypteris totta, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris totta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
